lastCompletedStory.title: Pure Kahn topo-sort + WSJF ranking module (src/issues/rank.ts)

nextStoryContext: src/issues/rank.ts exports rankIssues(backlog: IssueEntry[]): RankResult with { ranked, warnings, residualIds }. residualIds is the Kahn residual set (cycle members with in-degree > 0 after exhaustion) -- exposed specifically for US-003's cycle-detection gate. The numericIdSuffix helper is private inside rank.ts (mirrors select.ts). Test coverage: 24 tests across layering, WSJF ordering, id tie-break, missing-wsjf/jobSize<=0 warnings, shipped-blocker handling, and cycle detection.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure algorithm story: no external npm library was introduced or changed. rank.ts has zero imports from outside the project.
